findings.evidence: Both "Save" buttons return to no confirmation state, while the parallel invite flow (section#invite-sent) and archive flow (section#project-archived) each show a dedicated confirmation screen after their primary action

findings.violation: The flow is inconsistent - some actions (invite, archive) confirm success with a dedicated screen, while others (name save, notification save) give no feedback at all.
